Name: Joja's Hauntings
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=3][b]Happy Halloween!
[/b][/size]This is my favorite time of the year so I just had to put something out to fit the theme.
Enjoy this time of the year, you might not be here for it next year....

[b]Compatible with 1.5[/b]

[size=3][b]Requirements :
[/b][/size]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿

[size=3][b]Details : 
[/b][/size]This mod is centered around a scavenger hunt in joja mart, find all the items and beat the final objective to win a modest prize.
[u]Note[/u] : Everything happens inside the store and only happens a day before spirits eve, if you don't do it then, you have to wait till next year.

[size=3][b]Installation Details : 
[/b][/size]- Download
- Unzip in games mods folder
- Launch game
